name: The PC-Minor Closure of Learning Spaces Is the Convex-Geometry Ideal Class
statement: Up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants, $\operatorname{Cl}_{pc}(\mathsf{Learn})=\mathsf{Icg}$.
proof: Projection preserves learning spaces, so every pc-minor is a conditioning of a projected learning space and lies in the conditioning closure. The reverse inclusion holds because every conditioning is a pc-minor. The exact conditioning closure is $\mathsf{Icg}$.
